subject: Stakeholder mapping & champion enablement — FinovateBank
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Barnes <sophie@finovatebank.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call recap + next steps (stakeholder mapping)

Thanks again for the call earlier today — great context on your clinical workflows and the integration points you flagged. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned:

- Goal: pilot Redwood Inference for patient-facing triage prompts to reduce triage time and improve consistency.
- Success criteria: 20% reduction in average triage time, maintain accuracy above 95% on the safety checklist, and API latency < 250ms 95th percentile.
- Timeline you mentioned: procurement + security review in Dec, pilot Jan start.

Assignees / immediate asks:
1) Sophie / Tom: can you confirm the economic buyer and the procurement contact? (We heard procurement@finovatebank.com as a placeholder).
2) Sophie: please share any internal stakeholder mapping (security, legal, procurement, engineering, and the clinical champion). I sketched a starting list during the call — if you can add names/roles that helps speed review.
3) Rishi / Vivek (cc'd): we'll prepare a short champion enablement bundle (talk tracks, ROI slide, and a one-page security summary) — plan to share by EOD Thursday.

Attachments we'll send in follow-up: champion playbook + ROI calc.

Proposed next meeting: 30-minute enablement with internal champions and procurement — are mornings next week easiest?

Thanks — excited to keep momentum.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0142

--
Redwood Inference | Production-grade LLM inference for product teams

From: Sophie Barnes <sophie@finovatebank.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Ellis <t.ellis@finovatebank.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + next steps (stakeholder mapping)

Hi Marissa — thanks for the clear recap. A few notes and an initial stakeholder map below. I attached our standard procurement checklist (procurement-checklist.pdf) — it has the high-level timing we usually follow.

Stakeholders (initial):
- Economic buyer: Tom Ellis, VP Product (decision owner)
- Champion: Sophie Barnes, Dir Clinical Ops (day-to-day sponsor)
- Security reviewer: Priya Natarajan, InfoSec (will run SOC2 checklist)
- Legal contact: Olga Petrov, Counsel (contract redlines)
- Procurement: procurement@finovatebank.com (procurement coordinator)
- Engineering contact: Lukas Meyer, Senior Eng (integration touchpoint)

Procurement / security timeline: procurement kickoff in first week of Dec, security questionnaire back to vendor by ~Dec 10, legal review mid-Dec. We usually aim for a Jan pilot kickoff if there are no major redlines.

Next steps for us: I'll share Priya and Olga's availability for a technical Q&A. Tom and I are available for a 30-min champion enablement call next Tue/Wed morning.

Regards,
Sophie Barnes
Director, Clinical Operations
Sophie.Barnes@finovatebank.com

Attachments: procurement-checklist.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Barnes <sophie@finovatebank.com>, Tom Ellis <t.ellis@finovatebank.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 11:45:00 -0800
Subject: Champion enablement bundle + proposed MAP

Appreciate the stakeholder map, Sophie — that's perfect. Per our assignment, attached are two items to help your champion run the internal case: 

1) redwood-champion-playbook.pdf — one-pager talk tracks, objection handling, and a sample email Sophie can use to brief Priya / Olga.
2) roi-calculator.xlsx — conservative modeled ROI based on the metrics you shared on the call (we assume 20% triage time reduction).

I've also drafted a short mutual action plan below — feel free to edit and share internally: 
- Week of Dec 1: procurement kickoff (FinovateBank) -> vendor questionnaire (FinovateBank)
- By Dec 10: security questionnaire returned (Redwood provides SOC2 evidence + one-page architecture)
- Mid-Dec: legal review and final SOW negotiation
- Jan 4: pilot kickoff (2-4 week scope)

Proposed champion enablement times: Tue Dec 1 9:30–10:00am PT or Wed Dec 2 10:00–10:30am PT. Which works best?

If helpful, I can run a 15-min dry run with Sophie beforehand to walk through the playbook.

Thanks — attaching the files now.

Best,
Marissa

Attachments: redwood-champion-playbook.pdf, roi-calculator.xlsx

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>

Looping in Vivek (commercial lead) to ensure pricing/PO flow is clear for procurement. Vivek — we usually provide a standard pilot SOW and a one-time pilot credit for initial evaluation. If FinovateBank needs an accelerated procurement path or an internal purchase order, let me know and we can prioritize legal review.

Sophie — can you confirm if procurement requires insurance certs or any special security attestations beyond SOC2? If so, send those contacts and we'll prep them right away.

Rishi
